title: Collision Bound for Hashed Pairs
statement: Let $S$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be finite sets, with $S$ and $\beta$ nonempty, and let $f\colon S\to\alpha\to\beta$ be universal in the sense that for every pair of distinct inputs in $\alpha$, at most a fraction $1/|\beta|$ of the seeds in $S$ map them to the same output. For any probability distribution $X$ on $\alpha$, the collision probability of the distribution of $(s,f(s,x))$, with $s$ uniform on $S$ and $x$ distributed according to $X$ independently, is at most $\frac{1}{|S|}\bigl(\operatorname{Coll}(X)+\frac{1}{|\beta|}\bigr)$, where $\operatorname{Coll}(X)=\sum_{x\in\alpha}X(x)^2$.
